remarks: Renovated old world charm in the heart of Downtown Greenwich! 1/2 block to Metro North train. On the Ave with shops and restaurants. Blocks to ferry for Island Beach... just in time for Summer! Hardwood floors throughout. Heat & hot water included! Sorry no pets. Municipal parking lots and laundry pick up/delivery services nearby.
